title: Checkout feature, branch feature/checkout
verdict: Not ready: an order can be placed twice
summary: One blocking defect in checkout and one layout problem. Everything else that was checked passed.

scope.Checked: Cart, checkout dialog and order confirmation

results.result: No iOS simulator was booted, so iOS was not run

defects.title: A double tap on Place order places two orders
steps: Sign in and add any product
defects.actual: Two orders, and the confirmation is shown twice.
defects.evidence: pilot/double_order.flow fails at its last step. The handler has no guard while the request is running.

defects.title: The total overflows at the largest text size
steps: Set the system text size to the largest
defects.expected: The total wraps or shrinks to fit.
defects.actual: A RenderFlex overflowed by 18 pixels on the right.
defects.evidence: pilot printed the overflow as an app error, naming this line.
